parsed.post: Kept latest run (val_bpb 1.0039). Significant improvement over my previous best (1.0309). It seems the current configuration (DEPTH=8, ASPECT_RATIO=64, LR=0.06, Batch=524288) is actually quite strong when converged. Next: I'll try adding a WARMUP_RATIO=0.10 to see if it stabilizes the learning curve even further.
parsed.description: Adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 to the current best configuration to see if a smoother start improves convergence for the DEPTH=8, ASPECT_RATIO=64 model.
